subject: Request: temporary credits & quota increase for CodeTogether summer bootcamp
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena@codetogether.org>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@foundation.org>
Date: Tue, 22 May 2028 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Request: temporary credits & quota increase for CodeTogether summer bootcamp

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for taking a quick call last week. CodeTogether runs a six-week immersive data-and-AI bootcamp for community college students from underrepresented backgrounds; we're scaling to three cohorts this summer (late June - August) and we urgently need temporary capacity to avoid turning students away.

Concretely we're asking Redwood for:
- A promotional credit pool of ~150,000 token-equivalents to cover instructor-led demos, student notebooks, and end-of-week projects for the program window (6 weeks).
- A temporary increase in concurrent request quota to 8 concurrent inference streams for the duration of the program (we'll bring load below that by queuing, but peak times spike during lab sessions).

Budget context: our foundation partners covered facility and instructor costs; there isn't liquidity in the program budget for additional cloud credits this cycle. We are a 501(c)(3) nonprofit; attached is a short program proposal and a one-page budget brief for review.

Requested timeline: we need confirmation by Friday, 1 Jun so we can finalize lab schedules and student onboarding. Happy to accept any modified package (e.g., fewer tokens + concurrency ramp) if that makes approval easier.

If helpful, Samir at the Foundation is on the thread — they've been supportive and can provide a short endorsement.

Thanks again,

Elena Ruiz
Executive Director
CodeTogether Community Labs
elena@codetogether.org
(415) 555-0123

Attachments: bootcamp-proposal.pdf (12 pages), budget-brief.xlsx (1 sheet)

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena@codetogether.org>
Date: Wed, 23 May 2028 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary credits & quota increase for CodeTogether summer bootcamp

Thanks for the note, Elena — and thanks for the attachments. This is exactly the sort of public-interest education program we'd like to support.

Ben / Marissa — looping you both in to confirm capacity and an approval path. A few quick asks so we can move quickly:
- Ben: can we provision a short-term quota bump (concurrency + soft token cap) for a single non-commercial nonprofit account? Please confirm whether 150k tokens + 8 concurrency is operationally feasible for a 6-week window. If there's a recommended alternative (e.g., 175k tokens with staged concurrency), flag it.
- Marissa: do we have a standard promotional credit template we can apply to nonprofits (approval threshold, SLA exceptions, MPA requirement)? If we need executive sign-off, suggest who should be looped in.

Elena — we try to avoid lengthy procurement for this tier. If we can offer a pilot package with a short MPA (term outlining data controls and use limits) I think that will get you across the finish line. I can commit to turning around an approval once Ben confirms capacity.

Mina Haddad
Head of Community Programs & Partnerships
Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Thu, 24 May 2028 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary credits & quota increase for CodeTogether summer bootcamp

Mina — quick operational check. Short answer: yes, we can do this as a temporary, account-scoped promotional package. A few details and recommendations: 

1) Token allocation: I recommend 175,000 token-equivalents for the 6-week window. That gives a 15% buffer over the ask to cover instructor demos and student retries.
2) Concurrency: we can raise to 10 concurrent streams for the program window and set automated throttling during scheduled lab hours if needed. If you prefer a gentler bump, 8 concurrency is also fine.
3) Enforcement: we'll set a soft cap at the total tokens with notification emails when usage hits 75% and 95% of the pool. Any overage will be blocked unless we approve a top-up.
4) Timebox: recommend start date 2028-06-20 (cohort start) through 2028-08-02 (end of last cohort). We can extend if there's clear need but prefer a single defined window for bookkeeping.

I've attached a short operational note (quota-plan.txt) with the exact config I'll push to staging for approval. If you want, I can demo the throttling behavior during a quick call.

Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: quota-plan.txt

Subject: Approved: pilot credit package for CodeTogether summer bootcamp

Hi Elena — great to connect and thanks for being patient while we reviewed this.

Good news: Redwood will provide a pilot promotional package for CodeTogether. Approved package below (finalized after a small operational tweak):
- 175,000 token-equivalents allocated to CodeTogether account CT-2028-045
- Concurrency: 8 slots guaranteed, temporary burst to 10 during scheduled lab hours; automated throttles otherwise
- Window: 2028-06-20T00:00:00Z through 2028-08-02T23:59:59Z (we can extend by request)
- Monitoring: we'll send usage alerts at 75% and 95% consumption and block any overage unless you request a top-up

Next steps:
1) Please e-sign a short non-commercial MPA (DocuSign link below) which documents permitted uses and data handling for the pilot. DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/seed-approval/CT-2028-045
2) Ben will provision the quota configuration and share the initial throttling demo.
3) If your foundation partner (Samir) wants a short endorsement or invoicing note, we can provide a one-page letter for reporting.

I've attached the internal quota plan for your records. If you need adjustments to start date or token allocation, reply here and we'll triage quickly.

Happy to support — excited to see this cohort in action.

Best,

Mina Haddad
Head of Community Programs & Partnerships
Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: quota-plan.txt
